Hi all — quick legal note and an option set to unblock procurement while protecting both parties.

Minimum coverage (Redwood preferred language):
- Commercial General Liability (CGL): 1,000,000 each occurrence / 2,000,000 aggregate OR 1,000,000 each occurrence / 1,000,000 aggregate plus 2,000,000 Umbrella.
- Professional Liability (E&O): 1,000,000 per claim / 1,000,000 aggregate (preferred 2,000,000 for customer-facing production deployments).
- Automobile Liability: 1,000,000 CSL (combined single limit).
- Workers' Compensation: statutory limits; employer's liability 500,000.
- Cyber/Network Security: 2,000,000 aggregate (for any services that process customer data or production telemetry).

Endorsement & COI requirements:
- COI must name: “Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents” as Additional Insured for CGL and Auto where applicable.
- Waiver of Subrogation required where permitted by law for Workers' Compensation and CGL.
- COI must list policy number, carrier, limits, policy period dates, and indicate whether any policies are on a claims-made basis.

Sequencing options (pick one):
Option A (preferred for customer-facing/production): Endorsement and evidence of AI delivered and effective prior to Order Form execution / go-live.
Option B (expedited POC path): COI showing the required limits + signed Order Form allowed to proceed, PROVIDED the full signed endorsement and insurer confirmation are delivered within 14 business days post-go-live. Legal must approve this exception in writing.

If Nova chooses Option B, we will require an internal escalation if endorsement delivery slips beyond 14 business days. Please note: certain carriers will not provide retrospective endorsement language; if that is the case, an alternative carrier certificate or higher umbrella may be required.

I've attached an endorsement example and inline redline to the MSA insurance section. If you want, I can create a short addendum clause for the order form that codifies Option B timelines so procurement has something to sign.

Action items:
- Nova / broker: confirm which option you prefer and provide a COI showing current limits (7 business days).
- Redwood Legal (me): will draft a short exception addendum if Option B is requested.
- Sales Ops (Aditya): add a deal note and timeline for acceptance escalation.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
